scope: Counter source recovery analysis and isolated automated contracts; this file is not evidence of manual browser or physical-camera execution.

fixes.cause: An authenticated cashier has a selected order and online=true; GET used to open a QR/order fails with a network error or HTTP 429.
fixes.before: The UI displayed an error but retained online=true, allowing the old payment/status button until a later queue poll failed.
fixes.after: Network and 429 failures retain the last known order, set online=false and re-render disabled write actions. A successful queue refresh restores the usual action path. 403/404 invalid or inaccessible IDs retain their existing not-found handling.
fixes.reproductionEvidence: The new VM test failed before the source fix: online true !== false.
fixes.regressionTest: a failed QR read disables actions on retained details until the queue reconnects

fixes.cause: A sign-out request is pending; locale changes increment the request generation and abort the request.
fixes.before: The logout finally branch ignored the changed generation and left both login and retry-sign-out disabled. The protected data was hidden but recovery became unreachable.
fixes.after: Locale selection is disabled while sign-out is pending, and the handler rejects a pending locale change. On completion or failure the selector, login and retry controls are enabled again; a network failure exposes retry-sign-out and does not claim the server session is revoked.
fixes.reproductionEvidence: The new VM test failed before the source fix: login-submit disabled true !== false.
fixes.regressionTest: changing language during sign out cannot strand the login or retry controls

contractCoverage.evidence: HTTP authentication, password hashing, expiry/revocation, role, Origin, host, body bounds and CSRF server tests; manual UI expiry and rate-limit feedback still need browser evidence.
Atomic/idempotent server writes and VM delayed queue/direct QR response contracts. The server confirms versions and the role-filtered queue cannot resurrect issued barista work.
Server ticket/guest idempotency and conflict tests; guest private-fragment key persistence, blocked-storage retry and matching-capability receipt tests. These are not manual browser executions.
Guest transition/offline/lost-create simulation, all three localized receipt GETs, failed-payment uncertainty, logout late-response cleanup, and new locale/sign-out recovery contract.

Server restart with retained SQLite, quote/session/audit persistence, wire/canonical quote rejection, high-volume/aged queue bounds, isolated polling limits, service-worker bypass and live endpoint no-store contracts.

Staff QR URL contains only the order ID; model parser enforces same-origin staff path; payment current/version/amount guards are unit-tested. Camera scan, checkbox/dialog interaction and visual readability require separate browser evidence.

guestLocaleFollowup.cause: Guest language is taken from the private link and explicit guest selection, while the client menu independently reads the existing robys-language preference.
guestLocaleFollowup.before: An explicit RU to EN guest switch did not update the site preference; Start a new order reopened the menu in a previously stored language such as Turkish.
guestLocaleFollowup.after: Explicit guest language choices and the issued-order continuation save only the shared robys-language key before continuing. Opening an existing QR alone does not overwrite an existing site preference. Storage access errors are caught so selection and navigation remain usable.
verifiedActualHandlers: Opening a RU guest link with a stored TR preference leaves TR unchanged until a user choice.
Explicit EN and TR language clicks update the same shared site preference without changing an unrelated setting.
Starting a new order from a RU issued receipt saves RU before navigating even when the previous site preference was TR.
Blocked storage does not throw from language selection or from Start a new order.
guestLocaleFollowup.limitation: When localStorage is blocked, the destination menu cannot read a persisted preference; this scoped fix keeps navigation working and does not add a new URL-language protocol.
